parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, typically rectangular and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open or close the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box that supports all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the shelves and door.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the internal shelves made of particle board, rectangular in shape and fitted inside the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: This is another internal shelf made of particle board, similar to the other shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and supports items placed on it.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: This is the top internal shelf made of particle board, forming part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps organize the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
